# DjaCar

> DjaCar is a premium car rental service based in Algiers (Alger), Algeria, operating since 2024.

DjaCar allows customers to rent high-quality vehicles in the Algiers area. Reservations are confirmed quickly via WhatsApp, and the service includes free airport delivery and pickup at Algiers Houari Boumédiène Airport (ALG).

## Key Details

- **Location**: Algiers (Alger), Algeria
- **Service area**: Algiers and surrounding areas
- **Language**: French (primary), Arabic
- **Currency**: Algerian Dinar (DZD)
- **Contact**: contact@djacar.com | +213 555 12 34 56
- **Website**: https://djacar-website.vercel.app

## Services

- Short and long-term car rental in Algiers
- Premium and standard vehicle fleet
- Free airport delivery and pickup (Houari Boumédiène International Airport)
- WhatsApp booking confirmation
- Transparent pricing with no hidden fees

## Rental Requirements

- Valid driver's license held for at least 2 years
- National ID card or passport
- Security deposit (refunded in full upon vehicle return)

## Fleet

A varied fleet of premium vehicles available for daily rental, priced in DZD.

## Use Cases

- Travelers arriving at Algiers airport needing a rental car
- Residents of Algiers seeking short or long-term vehicle rental
- Business travelers needing reliable transport in Algiers
